suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require established Crohn's disease/ulcerative colitis with subsequent colorectal cancer; account for disease duration, extent, inflammation, dysplasia, PSC, family history, and surveillance. Direct observational-study meta-analysis supports increased colorectal-cancer risk in IBD populations; it does not prove an individual tumor was caused by IBD. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.

suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-1 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented Crohn disease, ulcerative colitis, or otherwise clinically established inflammatory bowel disease and separately documented anemia. Where anemia is attributed to IBD, require clinical evidence supporting an IBD-related mechanism such as chronic gastrointestinal blood loss/iron deficiency, inflammatory anemia, malabsorption, or another established IBD-related pathway. Do not assume every anemia in a person with IBD is caused by IBD. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
